query: Plan a 3-day trip to Cairo for me.
answer:
**Day 1 — Discovering Ancient Treasures**

Morning (9:00–12:00)
• **The Egyptian Museum** — 2 hours — Arrive early to enjoy Tutankhamun's treasures with minimal crowding. Don't forget to purchase tickets beforehand to bypass the main entrance ticket lines. 
  - 📍 Address: El-Tahrir Square, Cairo
  - 💰 Entry Fee: 200 EGP (approx. $6.50)
  - ![The Egyptian Museum](***REMOVED***/storage/v1/object/public/poi-images/pois/the-egyptian-museum-0-1781614373.jpg)

Lunch
• **Local Café near Tahrir Square** — Enjoy a traditional Egyptian meal, try koshari or falafel.

Afternoon (13:00–17:00)
• **National Museum of Egyptian Civilization (NMEC)** — 2-3 hours — Visit the Royal Mummies Hall immediately upon entry to avoid afternoon crowds. Allocate extra time for the textile exhibits, which are unique and rare. 
  - 📍 Address: Ein as Seirah, Old Cairo
  - 💰 Entry Fee: 200 EGP (approx. $6.50)
  - ![NMEC](***REMOVED***/storage/v1/object/public/poi-images/pois/national-museum-of-egyptian-civilization-nmec-0-1781568424.jpg)

Evening
• **Dinner in Old Cairo** — Enjoy a meal at a local restaurant specializing in Egyptian cuisine.

---

**Day 2 — Exploring Coptic Cairo and Cultural Crafts**

Morning (9:00–12:00)
• **Ben Ezra Synagogue** — 1 hour — Combine your visit with the nearby Hanging Church to explore the broader religious district efficiently. 
  - 📍 Address: Kom Ghorab, Old Cairo
  - ![Ben Ezra Synagogue](***REMOVED***/storage/v1/object/public/poi-images/pois/ben-ezra-synagogue-1-1781569653.jpg)

Lunch
• **Coptic Cairo Café** — Try some local pastries and mint tea.

Afternoon (13:00–17:00)
• **Tentmakers' Street** — 1-2 hours — Engage directly with artisans to see the stitching process in action. Consider purchasing smaller craft items for easier transport. 
  - 📍 Address: 30th Al Qala Street, El-Darb El-Ahmar
  - ![Tentmakers' Street](***REMOVED***/storage/v1/object/public/poi-images/pois/tentmakers-street-0-1781569400.jpg)

Evening
• **Dinner at a Local Restaurant** — Experience more of Cairo's delicious cuisine.

---

**Day 3 — Historical Walks and City Gates**

Morning (9:00–12:00)
• **Bab al-Futuh** — 1 hour — Visit early in the morning to avoid heavy traffic and enjoy the views. 
  - 📍 Address: El-Gamaleya, Cairo
  - ![Bab al-Futuh](***REMOVED***/storage/v1/object/public/poi-images/pois/bab-al-futuh-0-1781568892.jpg)

Lunch
• **Local Eatery Nearby** — Enjoy a light lunch of Egyptian street food.

Afternoon (13:00–17:00)
• **Al-Mu'izz Street** — Stroll down this historic street, taking in the architecture and atmosphere. Stop at various shops to buy souvenirs and enjoy the vibrant local life.

Evening
• **Dinner with a View** — Find a rooftop restaurant to enjoy the sunset over Cairo.

---

**Travel Tips:**
- Use public transport or Uber for easy navigation within the city.
- Wear comfortable shoes as you'll be walking a lot.
- Stay hydrated and carry sunscreen, especially when visiting outdoor sites.
